Name: Green Rain Toggle
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
Description
Once every summer, Stardew 1.6 sends a day of Green Rain: weeds and mossy bushes cover the paths, trees grow huge and green, and the next morning you're clearing up. If you'd rather skip it, this mod turns it off.

The day Green Rain would have come gets normal rain instead. If you'd rather have that day's normal random weather, you can switch that in the config.

Calendar switch: the calendar on the town billboard has a small weather symbol at the top right, in every season. Click it to turn Green Rain on or off. Hover over it to see whether it is on or off.

Nothing that's already in your world is removed. Mossy trees, moss on trees and trees that grew up during an earlier Green Rain all stay. The mod only stops new Green Rain days.

What changes:
- No Green Rain, no Green Rain weeds or bushes, no temporary Green Rain trees.
- The TV weather forecast shows rain (or the normal forecast) for that day.
- Moss still grows on trees as usual, just without the big Green Rain boost. Moss and Mossy Seeds stay available.
- In year 1, Green Rain comes with a few one-time moments (a letter from Gus, the town meeting at the saloon). These are skipped too. Turn on "Keep it in year 1" if you want to keep them.
- Robin keeps building on that day.

A Green Rain that's already happening when you install the mod or change the setting finishes normally and is cleaned up the next morning, as usual. Changes take effect from the next day.

Config:
Edit config.json (created on first launch) or use Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Enabled (default: on): turns Green Rain off.
- ReplaceWithRain (default: on): the day Green Rain would have come gets normal rain. Turn it off to get that day's normal random weather instead.
- KeepFirstYear (default: off): keeps Green Rain in the first year, so its one-time story moments still happen.

Console command: green_rain_day shows which summer day Green Rain would come this year.

Compatibility:
- Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+
- Multiplayer: the weather is decided by the host, so the host needs the mod. Other players don't need it.
- Safe to add or remove at any time.
- Translations: English, German.

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip the mod into your Mods folder.
3. Start the game through SMAPI.

Main features
- Doesn't remove anything: existing mossy trees and moss stay
- Optional: keep Green Rain in the first year for its story moments
- Can be turned off any time in the config or Generic Mod Config Menu

Requirements
- SMAPI (required)
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for the other settings; the calendar switch works without it)

Shout outs
Thanks to the Steam community thread that asked for a way to turn off Green Rain.

AI disclosure: This mod was made with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude by Anthropic). I came up with the idea, decided how it should behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result. The AI wrote most of the code.
